title.zh: PageRank · 随机冲浪者最后停在哪
title.en: PageRank · Where the Random Surfer Ends Up

desc.zh: 被链接得最多的网页就最重要吗？用一个随机冲浪者把「重要」变成概率，再用迭代算出来，看阻尼系数和一条新链接怎样改变排名。
desc.en: Is the most linked-to page the most important? Turn “important” into a probability with a random surfer, compute it by iteration, and see how the damping factor and one new link change the ranking.

legacyLayout._note: Whitespace and markup of the hand-written lesson this page was converted from, so the conversion could be checked byte for byte (specs/site-template.md §3c).
